raceSummary.headline: Nobody major has declared, and the midterms reopened both primaries.
paragraphs: Democrats won both chambers of Congress on Nov. 3, with at least 54 Senate seats and 254 House seats and some races still uncalled. They flipped Senate seats in Texas, Ohio, Iowa, Kansas, North Carolina, Maine, South Carolina and Mississippi.

Republicans are arguing over the cause. JD Vance blames the Iran war, Marco Rubio defends it, Ron DeSantis says the party fought yesterday's battle, and Ted Cruz blames tariffs and the length of the war. Donald Trump said he may stay out of the primary.
On the Democratic side Kamala Harris leads national polls but drew 0.6% in the Crooked Con straw poll. Jon Ossoff, who says he has zero interest in running, won it with 38.4%.
